source_refs.title: If you can't receive email on your iPhone or iPad - Apple Support
source_refs.section: Check Mail Fetch and Notification settings
source_refs.applicability: iPhone or iPad with the Mail app; background fetch rules apply on iOS 11 and later and iPadOS
source_refs.verified_excerpt: If you can't receive email in the Mail app on your iPhone or iPad, there are a few things you can try.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone or iPad: Go to Settings, then tap Apps. Choose Mail, then tap Mail Accounts. Tap Fetch New Data and select a setting such as Automatically or Manually, or a schedule. On iOS 11 and later, and iPadOS, Automatically is the default. Background fetching then happens only while the device is charging and on Wi-Fi.

source_refs.title: If you can't receive email on your iPhone or iPad - Apple Support
source_refs.section: Remove your email account and set it up again
source_refs.applicability: iPhone or iPad; the page says deleting account settings can remove previously downloaded emails
source_refs.verified_excerpt: If these steps fail, contact your email provider.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone or iPad: On a computer, sign in to your provider's website and confirm your email is saved elsewhere. On the device, go to Settings, tap Apps, choose Mail, then tap Mail Accounts. Tap the account, then tap Delete Account. Add the account again, following the linked Apple article. If these steps fail, contact your email provider.

source_refs.title: Can't send or receive email in Outlook.com | Microsoft Support
source_refs.applicability: Outlook.com accounts; the storage rule applies to Microsoft cloud storage
source_refs.verified_excerpt: If your Microsoft cloud storage is full, you cannot send or receive email.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Outlook.com: If your Microsoft cloud storage is full, you can't send or receive mail. Check your mailbox storage to see what's using space. Attachments over 25 MB can't be sent. If a signature causes an error, remove it and resend. Ask recipients to add your address to their safe senders list, and add recipients to your Contacts.

source_refs.title: Can't send or receive email in Outlook.com | Microsoft Support
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Check the Other tab for filters.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Outlook.com: Check the Other tab for filters. Check Junk Email settings and the Junk Email folder. To move a wrongly filtered message back, right-click it and choose Mark as not junk. Check for email forwarding and email rules that might hide messages.
